full_judgment: 72. Thus the present case is an ideal one which the aged-long maxim "Man may tell a lie but circumstances do not" applied in full force. In this case a well-knit chain of circumstances and some vital facts of grave significance stand out prominently against the prosecution and sharply react in favour of a presumption of innocence of accused appellant.
